info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the update of specific operational service records based on the provided parameter, 'param1'. It allows businesses to modify detailed channel activity history associated with operational services, ensuring data relevance and accuracy. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and service administrators who need to maintain up-to-date records. In use cases, this API aids in real-time system adjustments and optimizations to enhance customer interactions.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the channel activity history for a specified resource. It is essential for maintaining the accuracy and relevance of channel data within the operational services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the channel activity history for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It contains the necessary information to modify the existing resource attributes, ensuring that the channel's operational data is accurately represented.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource was updated.
